persona: Quality analyst in a finance-and-accounting BPO moving into process excellence
resumeText:
Arjun Menon | Bengaluru | arjun.menon@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Quality Analyst, Nandi Business Process Services, Bengaluru (2021 - present)
- Led a Green Belt project using DMAIC to cut invoice processing errors from 3.1% to 1.2% for a US client.
- Mapped the as-is and to-be accounts payable process with swimlane flowcharts for three client processes.
- Used fishbone diagram and Pareto analysis to find the top causes of SLA breaches.
- Built control charts in Minitab to track daily accuracy after process changes went live.
- Built a weekly SLA and KPI dashboard in Power BI for the operations leadership team.
- Analysed transaction volumes and error logs in Excel to size improvement opportunities.
- Worked with operations managers and the client process owner to sign off and sustain the new process.

Process Associate, Nandi Business Process Services, Bengaluru (2019 - 2021)
- Processed vendor invoices and met daily accuracy targets.

SKILLS
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Minitab, Power BI, Excel, kaizen

CERTIFICATIONS
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (2023)

EDUCATION
B.Com, Christ University, 2019
